# defectdojo_development_environment (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo development environment, the environment a test ran in, such as `Production`. DefectDojo comes with seven: Development, Staging, Production, Test, Pre-prod, Lab and Default. Managing environments needs a superuser or the development environment configuration permissions.

-> DefectDojo's imports find the environment of a scan by name (`Development` when the import names none), so keep names unique, and keep an environment named `Development` for imports that name none. Creating one with a name that an environment already has fails; import that environment instead. An environment that tests use can't be destroyed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_development_environment" "qa" {
  name = "QA"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the development environment. DefectDojo doesn't require names to be unique, but imports that name an environment fail when several have the name. At most 200 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the development environment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_development_environment.example
  identity = {
    id = 8
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the development environment

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Development environments are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_development_environment.example <id>
```
